newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's GITIC Ent offers 100 mln shrs at HK$1.05 each.
newsitem.headline: HK's GITIC Ent offers 100 mln shrs at HK$1.05 each.

text.p: Guangdong provincial government-backed GITIC Enterprises Ltd said on Thursday it would offer 100 million shares at HK$1.05 each in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong.
GITIC Enterprises engages in trading and processing of high quality marble, granite products and construction materials in Hong Kong and China.
It is indirectly controlled by the Guangdong provincial goverment's investment arm -- Guangdong International Trust and Investment Corp (GITIC).

The company said net proceeds of HK$90 million would be raised from the issue, of which HK$54 million would be used to buy machinery for its processing plant in Hua Du, Guangdong province, and HK$7 million to build a new plant in Hua Du.

About HK$18 million would be used to expand its construction materials' distribution network in Hong Kong and China, and the remaining HK$11 million would go to repayment of short-term bank borrowings and to working capital.
In addition to construction materials trading, the company owns the entire shopping mall on the second floor of GITIC Plaza, a 63-storey grade A commercial and five-star hotel complex in Guangzhou.
The shoppping mall has a gross floor area about 9,000 square-metres.
